lines.t: I have indeed lifted up my voice
To this lost and dying generation
I have spoken plainly to my people
Yet few have ears to hear
If you stop and pay attention
There's only those who seek that which is first
Who fill themselves up with that which is most needful
We'll finish the day with strength enough to face tomorrow
Yes, you're looking always to the blessed hope, having tasted of it while in waiting, says the Lord.
